nightlyRechargeResults.sleepTip: Try to go to bed always around the same time and maintain regular meal times. Every now and then, take a calm moment when you focus on the here and now. This helps you achieve a healthy sleep structure, which your body needs to recuperate.
nightlyRechargeResults.vitalityTip: Sit back and do something that makes you feel good. It's ok to take it easy every now and then.
nightlyRechargeResults.exerciseTip: Today might be a good day for rest. If you feel you're up for it, train only very lightly.
